status: Book-only canonical synthesis and exhaustive practice-level comparison complete; all 13 follow-up mapping gaps repaired. Exact sentence entailment remains explicitly partial.

source.authoritative_evidence: Local EPUB only. No external sources or current-runtime execution used.

method: Compare three complete independent semantic readings by mistake and clause. Preserve narrow practices, split composite observations when decisions differ, and consolidate equivalent recommendations with minority triggers and qualifications. Reconcile source-internal contradictions using EPUB examples. Keep all source-era claims visible for later release adaptation. Exact investigator clauses in reconciliation are audit evidence, not quotations from the book or a second operational guide.

practices.because: Speculative flexibility adds complexity without demonstrated value.
caveats: Evaluate real future compatibility needs, not imaginary generality.
